body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
Each protected creature also resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: Spend 2 Combo to enter Banner Stance: the first protected ally damaged before your next turn may move 1 unit into an empty space adjacent to you after the Damage.
